chapter: The Original Dixieland band to California
title: Heading to Oakland; Joe's first Los Angeles trip in 1923; Red Cayou
summary: Joe notes he first came to Los Angeles in 1923 after running off with a circus, and the band picked up pianist Red Cayou in Oakland for a restaurant and radio job.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: That was the first time you had been to California.
No, I had been here before. I came to Los Angeles first in 1923. But I had run off from home, come here...I'd joined the circus.
So we're getting now to the end of the Twenties, '26, '27, or somewhere like that.
That's right. You're getting there. So we had to get another piano player. I'm trying to think

whether we were leaving Los Angeles... Anyway, I think we went up to Oakland without a piano player, because we had a job waiting up there in a Greek restaurant and to play on a radio station. So we picked up a piano player named Red Cayou(?) in Oakland. In the meantime...
Where have I heard of him?
You've heard of him, because he...
No, "Kye-You." He was a pretty good piano player.
I believe Little Brother Montgomery was a friend of Red Cayou(?) and...
He was a real light-complected guy with red hair.

I think it was Little Brother that told me... Wait a minute, it's coming back a bit now. I think he was from the town outside of New Orleans where Little Brother was from, which is some logging town out there...oh Lord... Anyway, I've heard of him.
